headline: Cofounder and CEO at Nanotronics
addressWithCountry: New York, New York, United States
about:
Matthew Putman, PhD, is an American scientist, educator, musician, and film and stage producer. He is best known for his work in nanotechnology.
Putman currently serves as the CEO of Nanotronics, an advanced machines and intelligence company that has redefined factory control through the invention of a platform that combines AI, automation, and sophisticated imaging to assist human ingenuity in detecting flaws in manufacturing. He recently built New York State’s first high-tech manufacturing hub, located in Building 20 of the Brooklyn Navy Yard.
After receiving a B.A. in Music and Theater from Baldwin-Wallace University in Ohio, Putman worked as Vice President of Development for Tech Pro, Inc., a business launched by his parents, Kay and John Putman, in 1982. He later received a PhD in Applied Mathematics and Physics. He served as an adjunct professor and researcher at Columbia University. 
Matthew has published over 30 papers and is an inventor on over 50 patent applications filed in the U.S. and other countries for his work on manufacturing, automation, inspection, instrumentation, super resolution, and artificial intelligence. He is  an expert in quantum computing and a founding member of The Quantum Industry Coalition. His groundbreaking inventions in manufacturing include the development of the world’s most advanced inspection instrument, which combines super resolution, AI, and robotics. 
Matthew has lectured at the University of Paris, USC, University of Michigan, and The Technical University of São Paulo. 
Matthew is an Artist-in-Residence for Imagine Science Films, which seeks to build relationships between scientists and filmmakers. He most recently produced the critically acclaimed film, “Son of Monarchs” which premiered at Sundance in February 2021 and was awarded the Sloane Prize. also published a book of poems, Magnificent Chaos, partly written during his battle with esophagal cancer in 2005 (AuthorHouse, 2011).
Matthew is a jazz pianist and composer, and has played with jazz masters Ornette Coleman, Daniel Carter and Vijay Iyer. He has performed in several venues and festivals, including the Forward Festival. 
Releases with 577 Records: Whoadie (2002); Electric Telepathy Vol.1 (2019); Telepatia (2018); Telepathic Alliances (2017); WAKE UP! (2009); Gowanus Recordings (2008 & vinyl reissue 2018). His most recent jazz album was released on in April 2021 with 577 records, featuring Michael Sarian.
Matthew Putman serves on the Board of Directors of Pioneer Works and New York Live Arts.
www.matthewputman.com

recommendationsReceived.name: Amrut Nandan Biswal
recommendationsReceived.subtitle: R&D Leader | Digital/AI Enabled Innovation | MedTech and Pharma
recommendationsReceived.context: Amrut Nandan reported directly to Matthew
recommendationsReceived.description: Dr. Putman offered a class for "Polymers and Particles"  as research faculty at Columbia. I was enrolled in the course and found Dr. Putman's teaching as lucid and covering a broad range of subject matter. He has the unique ability to make topics easy to understand and create a genuine interest in the student's mind. His understanding about how complex systems are actually employed in the real world from his ventures is worth mentioning. He is very approachable and always ready to help anyone seeking his advice. I would endorse Dr. Matthew Putman as an excellent teaching faculty and had loved every moment of my class.

recommendationsReceived.name: Jeff Archer
recommendationsReceived.subtitle: Sr. Software Engineer
recommendationsReceived.description: I have known Matthew for over 25 years since he was in high school and I was managing software development at his father’s company.  I know that he has a great appreciation for the arts and a deep sense of commitment to helping his fellow man.  I have now worked for Matthew for over 3 years as the Director of Software Development at Nanotronics Imaging.  With already a team of 9 developers and customer service personnel Matthew’s commitment to a high quality product and world class customer service is obvious.  Matthew has a great sense for business, a clear vision and innovative product ideas that will certainly make Nanotronics a market leader.

recommendationsReceived.name: Jacques Arseneault
recommendationsReceived.subtitle: Business Sales Manager @ Pro-Flex Rubber | Direct Sales, Account Management
recommendationsReceived.description:
Mathiew is a visionary! 
Everything he touches turns to gold. He has an unusual business acumen that makes him an exceptional person and this without talking about his artistic side that is equally powerful. It was a great pleasure to work with and for him. It was unfortunately too short. There are people you meet who changes your life, Mathew is one of them. Mathiew is the kind of person who can work on multiple projects simultaneously while finding time for those he loves. He is a very charismatic character who deserves to be known. If you ever have a chance, you have to attend one of his Jazz performance.

recommendationsReceived.name: Brad Henry
recommendationsReceived.subtitle: Owner and Design Engineer at T.C.S. Technical Consulting Service
recommendationsReceived.context: Matthew was senior to Brad but didn't manage Brad directly
recommendationsReceived.description: Matthew is a very bright Scientist and Entrepreneur.  During our 13-year work experience at Tech Pro, Matthew quickly mastered rheology test methods and instrumentation manufacturing technologies.  Matthew's great personality and "unforgettable laugh" make him a real pleasure to work with!

recommendationsReceived.name: Robert Margolis
recommendationsReceived.subtitle: Robert Margolis is a writer, filmmaker & actor
recommendationsReceived.context: Robert worked with Matthew on the same team
recommendationsReceived.description: Matthew and I have worked together over the years on multiple film, theater, music and other arts-related projects. He is a person of extraordinary integrity, creativity, and productivity in the arts and the sciences. He is someone who inspires by his example and leads by the force of his vision, his intellectual courage and his sensitivity.

recommendations.name: Vann Walke
recommendations.subtitle: CTO at Vinli Inc
recommendations.description: Vann is one of the more talented high tech leaders I have worked with. He took a small business and worked through the challenging of running an acquisition, managing finances, fund rasing and setting up ISO procedures. He was also a CTO who implemented Agile development and advanced QA into the procedures.  Vann and I worked well together and his contributions will always be a part of what shaped the business.

recommendations.name: Julia Lautard
recommendations.subtitle: Public School Teacher
recommendations.description: My daughter was in Julia's second grade class. That year was a turning point for my daughter's intellectual and developmental curiosity. She (my daughter) learned to love poetry and see beyond the words alone. Most importantly Julia gave her and the other students a comfortable home where they wanted to attend. They were free to explore, while under the guidance and protection of her expertise and deep respect for both the students and the job. I feel lucky to have had her a a role model and teacher for my daughter.

recommendations.name: Jacob Keith
recommendations.subtitle: Director of Product @ Nanotronics | AI, Product Strategy
recommendations.description: Jacob is motivated like few students you encounter as a professor. He first took a graduate course from me when he was only a second year undergrad, and did extremely well. I am lucky to have worked with a student who will no doubt go on to be an important scientist and engineer.

recommendations.name: Donald Mcpherson
recommendations.subtitle: Founder at #theporchupstate
recommendations.context: Matthew worked with Donald but they were at different companies
recommendations.description: Donald is a person that makes me realize that I am a mere mortal when it comes to how I see the world. Donald is from another place. He sees texture, contrast and elegance in places where most of us miss it. He is a unique talent for his time, the way Cecil Beaton was for his. Like Beaton Donald doesn't reflect reality in its monotony but elevates it, while elevating all of us at the same time.

recommendations.name: Karen Starr
recommendations.subtitle: Interior Designer, Gallery Owner, Community Dreamer
recommendations.description: I have a business that is ultra high tech, in a region that it not known for high tech companies. I have always dreamed of surprising anyone who enters our business with beauty, creativity, design and utility. I wanted to give the staff something interesting than they would be getting in Silicon Valley. Karen did this for us. She was the best interior designer that I could have hoped for. She made our offices out of art, by artists, and a concept that fused my own ideologies, with her own vision. When I am in the offices I feel that we created something unique, and I can now do my job and create new technology. It inspires me and all of those who inhabit it.

recommendations.name: Pierre Diennet
recommendations.subtitle: AI Products | Governance | Strategy | GTM
recommendations.description: I was not producing plays when I heard Pierre give a reading of his play Perdita, which he wrote and acted in. Based upon that, I fully funded an entire off-Broadway production because I believed so much in this incredibly talented guy. I was neither rich, nor had a desire to produce, but I couldn't let this not be seen. I have known Pierre for a long time though, having worked with him in the 1990's. He was creative, intuitive and smart then. Since that time though he has become one of the most uniquely talented polyperformers in the world. That is he can do it all, and with emotion, heart and subtle grasp of humanity than few others could hope to achieve.

recommendations.name: Franck Lazare
recommendations.subtitle: Photography / Video Archives / Illustration
recommendations.description: Frank's photos were the most full of life, energy and passion that we had taken for the Off-Broadway play Perdita, and the opening night party. He was able to capture subtleties, and expression in ways that truly amazed me. I would hire him for any event or production

recommendations.name: Brad Henry
recommendations.subtitle: Owner and Design Engineer at T.C.S. Technical Consulting Service
recommendations.description: Brad is a poly-technician of hands on engineering. He is equal parts mechanical, electrical and computer engineer. Brad handled our major software products with creativity and skill. He is also inventive, having authored a patent with  us, and been involved with other original technical ideas.

recommendations.name: Alberto Ortiz
recommendations.subtitle: Owner, WORK Train Fight
recommendations.description: Alberto made me strong when I was week from cancer. He made me think it possible to be at peek performance when I felt at my lowest. Alberto is funny, tough, intellectually and physically challenging. I am so happy to see his success with WORK.

recommendations.name: Julie Orlando
recommendations.subtitle: Chief Product Officer
recommendations.description: Julie is not just an engineer. She knows how to interpret the complexities of design, client needs, and relationships with co-workers. Julie was one of the luckiest chances I had as a manager at Tech Pro. I didn't just turn to Julie for projects, I turned to her to make the company a better place. She handled international business, as well as domestic. She handled Information Technology, as well as mechanics. She was marketing, management and innovation all in one.

recommendations.name: Robert Margolis
recommendations.subtitle: Robert Margolis is a writer, filmmaker & actor
recommendations.context: Matthew worked with Robert on the same team
recommendations.description: Robert and i have worked together on films and plays for 12 years, and there is no one who I respect more intellectually and artistically. He is a writer and an actor with depth that is rare to see.

recommendations.name: Jacques Arseneault
recommendations.subtitle: Business Sales Manager @ Pro-Flex Rubber | Direct Sales, Account Management
recommendations.description: Jacques has it all when it comes to a technical sales and service leader. He works non stop, and has a creativity which is rare. His knowledge encompasses everything from Information technology, electronics, mechanics and chemistry. He is also a lot of fun, which makes co-workers and clients very thankful to be working with him.

recommendations.name: Thomas Campbell Jackson
recommendations.subtitle: I am an Investor, a Producer in Film and Theatre, and a Supporter of divers Arts and Sciences organizations.
recommendations.context: Matthew worked with Thomas Campbell but they were at different companies
recommendations.description: Thomas and I have been involved in several projects, including The World Science Festival, TED and some new Public Health ventures. He is so interested in ideas and action, and completely selfless in his desire to further those things he believes in.
